verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8000. That covers the core of launching a local OpenAI-compatible server. The docs only show serving the edge0-35b tier, so serving 'any loaded model' (arbitrary directories or other checkpoints) is not shown for the serve command, and only the chat-completions endpoint is documented. Missing for 10: evidence that serve works with any loaded model or directory, documentation of other OpenAI endpoints (models, completions, streaming), configuration options for the server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model
